# pronoun possessive

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:pronounPossessive`](gmeow-pronounPossessive.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the possessive pronoun form of a [`gmeow:PronounSet`](../classes/gmeow-PronounSet.md) — one of the five forms that define a custom set ('the book is theirs').

### Avoid when

- Avoid confusing it with the possessive determiner form ([`gmeow:pronounPossessiveDeterminer`](gmeow-pronounPossessiveDeterminer.md) — 'their book') and avoid filling only some of the five forms on a specifying set.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:pronounPossessive`](gmeow-pronounPossessive.md) once per [`gmeow:PronounSet`](../classes/gmeow-PronounSet.md) (functional), alongside the other four form properties when minting a custom set.

### Examples

- ex:set [`gmeow:pronounPossessive`](gmeow-pronounPossessive.md) "theirs".
